IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNT_OTH') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNT_OTH;
END;


WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)
, CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter 
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter A
	JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1' AND A.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS','TRY')
)
, CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL A
	JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS','TRY')
)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
,* 
INTO DW.ACCOUNT_OTH
FROM ( 
    
SELECT DISTINCT 
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (@DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')) --NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimeStamp desc) rn, CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,PeriodEndTimestamp  FROM BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS) BCAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAS.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode AND BCAS.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND (@DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') ) AND BCAS.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS','TRY')
)a

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA_OTH') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA_OTH;
END;


WITH
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_SRC
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountName)
    ,CONVERT(DATE,AccountOpenedDate)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountStatus)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PayrollIndicator)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CurrencyCode)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ProfitCostCode)
    ,CONVERT(INT,BankSK)
    ,CONVERT(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.ACCOUNT_OTH
)
,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountName)
    ,CONVERT(DATE,AccountOpenedDate)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountStatus)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,PayrollIndicator)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,CurrencyCode)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,ProfitCostCode)
    ,CONVERT(INT,BankSK)
    ,CONVERT(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode
    FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT WHERE CurrentIndicator = 1 AND SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS','TRY')
)

    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR
	,TGT.HASHROW AS TGT_HR
    ,ISNULL(SRC.AccountID,TGT.AccountID) AS AccountID
	,ISNULL(SRC.BankSK,TGT.BankSK) AS BankSK
	,ISNULL(SRC.SourceSystemCode,TGT.SourceSystemCode) AS SourceSystemCode
	,CASE
        WHEN  TGT.BankSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL THEN 'INSERT'
		WHEN SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW THEN 'UPDATE'
        ELSE NULL END AS RECORD_STATUS
INTO DW.TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA_OTH 	
FROM TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_SRC SRC
LEFT JOIN TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT	TGT
ON SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK
AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID
AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE SRC.HASHROW <> TGT.HASHROW OR ( TGT.BANKSK IS NULL AND TGT.AccountID IS NULL)

UPDATE TGT 
SET
 ValidEndDate = convert(date, DATEADD(day, -1, @DatetoProcessed))
,CurrentIndicator = 0
FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT TGT
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA_OTH DELTA ON  DELTA.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS = 'UPDATE'
JOIN DW.ACCOUNT_OTH SRC ON  SRC.BankSK = TGT.BankSK AND SRC.AccountID = TGT.AccountID AND SRC.SourceSystemCode = TGT.SourceSystemCode
WHERE TGT.CurrentIndicator = 1 AND TGT.SourceSystemCode NOT IN ('TRU','DEP','LNS','TRY');

 AccountSK

AccountSK

,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,ProfitCostCode
,BankSK
,BranchSK
,SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm FROM (
SELECT DISTINCT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY SRC.AccountID, SRC.BankSK, SRC.SourceSystemCode ORDER BY ValidEndDate DESC) RN
,AccountSK
,SRC.AccountID
,AccountName
,AccountOpenedDate
,AccountStatus
,PayrollIndicator
,CurrencyCode
,ProfitCostCode
,SRC.BankSK
,BranchSK
,SRC.SourceSystemCode
,CurrentIndicator
,ValidStartDate
,ValidEndDate
,WorkFlowId
,TaskRunId
,InsertDttm
FROM DW.ACCOUNT_OTH SRC
JOIN DW.TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA_OTH DELTA ON  DELTA.BankSK = SRC.BankSK AND DELTA.AccountID = SRC.AccountID AND DELTA.SourceSystemCode = SRC.SourceSystemCode AND  DELTA.RECORD_STATUS IN ('UPDATE','INSERT')
)A WHERE RN = 1

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNT_TRU') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNT_TRU;
END;


WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)
, CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter 
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter A
	JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1' AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'
)
, CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL A
	JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'
)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
,* 
INTO DW.ACCOUNT_TRU
FROM ( 
    
--FOR TRU RECORDS FILTER
SELECT
 BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,-1 AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT CA.CustomerAccountId,CA.CustomerAccountName,CA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CA.IsoCurrencyCode,CA.SourceSystemCode,CA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,CA.BRANCHID
FROM (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY CustomerAccountName) AS RN, CustomerAccountId, CustomerAccountName, CustomerAccountOpenedDate, IsoCurrencyCode, SourceSystemCode, FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID, BRANCHID 
FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) CA
WHERE CA.RN = 1) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (@DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') ) --NO DATA
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS BCAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAS.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode AND BCAS.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND (@DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') )
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
--LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRU'
GROUP BY 
BCA.CustomerAccountId
,BCA.CustomerAccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId
,BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID
,BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode
,DDB.BankSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId
)a

IF EXISTS(SELECT [name] FROM sys.tables WHERE [name] like 'ACCOUNT_LNS') 
BEGIN
   DROP TABLE DW.ACCOUNT_LNS;
END;


WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)
, CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter 
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter A
	JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1' AND A.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
)
, CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL
AS(
    SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL A
	JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode, MAX(Timestamp) Timestamp FROM BNKM.CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL GROUP BY CUSTOMERACCOUNTID, FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode ) B
	ON A.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = B.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.Timestamp = B.Timestamp AND A.SourceSystemCode = B.SourceSystemCode
    WHERE A.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS'
), 
	 CustomerAccountLoanPayoff
AS(
	SELECT distinct A.* FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanPayoff A
	 JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, MAX(PayoffTimestamp) PayoffTimestamp FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountLoanPayoff GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId ) B
		ON A.CustomerAccountId = B.CustomerAccountId AND A.FinancialInstitutionId = B.FinancialInstitutionId AND A.PayoffTimestamp = B.PayoffTimestamp
WHERE A.SOURCESYSTEMCODE = 'LNS'
)
,
CustomerAccountBalance_LNS AS (
SELECT 

	MAX(Timestamp) AS Timestamp
	,CustomerAccountId
	,FinancialInstitutionId
    ,BalancetypeId
	FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance
	WHERE BalancetypeId = 'Clear Balance Amount'
    GROUP BY CustomerAccountId, FinancialInstitutionId, BalancetypeId
)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
,*
INTO DW.ACCOUNT_LNS from ( 
SELECT DISTINCT
	BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
	,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
	,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
	--,CASE
	--	WHEN BCCA.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('LAA', 'CLA') AND BCAB.BalanceAmount = 0 
	--	THEN 'Closed' ELSE 'Active' END AS AccountStatus
	, CASE
        WHEN BCALP.PayoffIndicator = 'Y'
             AND CONVERT(DATE,BCALP.PayoffTimestamp) <=  @DatetoProcessed
             AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('LAA', 'CLA')
        THEN 'Closed'
        WHEN BCALP.PayoffIndicator = 'N'
             AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('LAA', 'CLA')
        THEN 'Active'
        WHEN BCALP.PayoffIndicator = 'Y'
             AND CONVERT(DATE,BCALP.PayoffTimestamp) >  @DatetoProcessed
             AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('LAA', 'CLA')
        THEN 'Active'
    END AS AccountStatus
	,CASE 
		 WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCAP.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
		 THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
	,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
	,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
	,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
	,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
	,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
	,1 AS CurrentIndicator
	,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
	,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
	,0 AS WorkFlowId
	,0 AS TaskRunId
    ,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm
FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
--LEFT JOIN BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount BCCA ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCA.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountLoanPayoff BCALP ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCALP.CustomerAccountId  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCALP.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCALP.SourceSystemCode
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT BCAB.* FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountBalance BCAB
--LEFT JOIN CustomerAccountBalance_LNS BCABL ON BCAB.Timestamp = BCABL.Timestamp AND BCAB.CustomerAccountId = BCABL.CustomerAccountId AND BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId = BCABL.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAB.BalancetypeId = BCABL.BalancetypeId
--WHERE BCAB.BalancetypeId = 'Clear Balance Amount' ) BCAB ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAB.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAB.FinancialInstitutionId
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(DATE,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate) = CONVERT(DATE,BCAF.PeriodStartDate)
--AND (BCAF.PERIODENDDATE IS NULL OR BCAF.PERIODENDDATE = '1900-01-01' )
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCAP ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCAP.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCAP.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCAP.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'LNS' AND BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate <= @DatetoProcessed

)a

   DROP TABLE DW.TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_DELTA_LNS;

,
TEMP_DW_DIMACCOUNT_TGT
AS(
    SELECT HASHBYTES('MD5',CONCAT(
     CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountID)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountName)
    ,CONVERT(DATE,AccountOpenedDate)
    ,CONVERT(VARCHAR,AccountStatus)

    ,CONVERT(INT,BranchSK)
    )) HASHROW, AccountID,BankSK ,SourceSystemCode

    SELECT	
	SRC.HASHROW AS SRC_HR

END;

WITH ACCOUNT_SK
AS(
SELECT ISNULL(MAX(AccountSk),0) RN FROM DW.DIMACCOUNT 

)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK, AccountID, AccountName, AccountOpenedDate, AccountStatus, PayrollIndicator, CurrencyCode, ProfitCostCode, BankSK ,BranchSK ,SourceSystemCode ,CurrentIndicator ,ValidStartDate ,ValidEndDate ,WorkFlowId ,TaskRunId ,InsertDttm
INTO DW.ACCOUNT_DEP 
FROM 
(SELECT DISTINCT
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,CASE
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate <= CONVERT(DATE,@DatetoProcessed) AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA') 
     THEN 'Closed'
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > CONVERT(DATE,@DatetoProcessed) AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('CAA', 'SBA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'Y' AND BCA.CustomerAccountClosedDate > CONVERT(DATE,@DatetoProcessed) AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN  BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     WHEN BCCACCT.ClosedAccountIndicator = 'N' AND BCAF.FcbsApplication IN ('TDA') 
     THEN BDAS.DepositAccountStatusTypeId
     END AS AccountStatus 
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.ProductId IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,CustomerAccountClosedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount where SourceSystemCode = 'DEP' ) BCA 
INNER JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,PERIODENDDATE,ProductId,FINANCIALPRODUCTID,PeriodStartDate,FcbsApplication FROM BNKM.CustomerAccountFinancialProduct  ) BCAF ON convert(varchar,BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND CONVERT(DATE,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate) = CONVERT(DATE,BCAF.PeriodStartDate)  
INNER JOIN DW.RefDepositVerifiedAccounts rdva on BCA.CustomerAccountId = rdva.FORACID and BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = rdva.Bnk_code --and BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate = rdva.ACCT_OPN_DATE
LEFT JOIN (SELECT FinancialProductId,SourceSystemCode,FinancialInstitutionId,FcbsApplicationId FROM DW.FINPRODAPP) FPA ON CONVERT(VARCHAR,BCAF.ProductId) = CONVERT(VARCHAR,FPA.FinancialProductId) AND BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId = FPA.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = FPA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode,ClosedAccountIndicator FROM BNKM.CoreCustomerAccount WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'  ) BCCACCT ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCACCT.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCACCT.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCACCT.SourceSystemCode
--LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,DepositAccountStatusTypeId FROM BNKM.DepositAccountStatus WHERE PeriodEndTimestamp IS NULL) BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimeStamp desc) rn, CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,DepositAccountStatusTypeId FROM BNKM.DepositAccountStatus WHERE  @DatetoProcessed between PeriodStartTimeStamp and replace(isnull(PeriodEndTimeStamp,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')) BDAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BDAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BDAS.FinancialInstitutionId  AND BDAS.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CUSTOMERACCOUNTID,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,SourceSystemCode,EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator FROM DW.CORECUSTACCPYROLL WHERE SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1 
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CustomerAccountId,FinancialInstitutionId,SourceSystemCode,ProfitCostCenterId FROM DW.CoreCustAccProCostCenter WHERE ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1' AND SourceSystemCode = 'DEP') BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode 
WHERE BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'DEP'
AND LEFT(TRIM(BCAF.ProductId),2) <> '09'
AND FPA.FcbsApplicationId IN ('CAA', 'SBA', 'TDA')
AND BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate <= CONVERT(DATE,@DatetoProcessed)

)A

)

SELECT
ROW_NUMBER() OVER(ORDER BY (SELECT NULL)) + (SELECT RN FROM ACCOUNT_SK) AS AccountSK
,* 
INTO DW.ACCOUNT_TRY
FROM ( 
    
SELECT DISTINCT 
BCA.CustomerAccountId AS AccountID
,BCA.CustomerAccountName AS AccountName
,BCA.CustomerAccountOpenedDate AS AccountOpenedDate
,BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId AS AccountStatus
,CASE 
     WHEN BCAF.FINANCIALPRODUCTID IN ('00013','01013') OR BCCA.EmployeePayrollAccountIndicator = 'Y' 
     THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS PayrollIndicator
,BCA.IsoCurrencyCode AS CurrencyCode
,BCCC.ProfitCostCenterId AS ProfitCostCode
,DDB.BankSK AS BankSK
,DDBRAN.BranchSK AS BranchSK
,BCA.SourceSystemCode AS SourceSystemCode
,1 AS CurrentIndicator
,@DatetoProcessed AS ValidStartDate
,'9999-12-31' AS ValidEndDate
,0 AS WorkFlowId
,0 AS TaskRunId
,CAST(SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' AS datetime) AS InsertDttm

FROM (SELECT DISTINCT CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountName,CustomerAccountOpenedDate,IsoCurrencyCode,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,BRANCHID FROM BNKM.CustomerAccount) BCA 
LEFT JOIN BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTFINANCIALPRODUCT BCAF ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = convert(varchar,BCAF.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID) AND BCAF.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode  AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCAF.FinancialInstitutionId AND (@DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31')) --NO DATA
LEFT JOIN (SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY CustomerAccountId ORDER BY PeriodStartTimeStamp desc) rn, CustomerAccountId,CustomerAccountStatusTypeId,SourceSystemCode,FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID,PeriodEndTimestamp  FROM BNKM.CUSTOMERACCOUNTSTATUS) BCAS ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCAS.CustomerAccountId AND BCAS.SourceSystemCode = BCA.SourceSystemCode AND BCAS.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND (@DatetoProcessed between periodstartdate and replace(isnull(periodenddate,'9999-12-31'),'1900-01-01','9999-12-31') ) AND BCAS.RN = 1
LEFT JOIN CORECUSTOMERACCOUNTPAYROLL BCCA ON BCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID = BCCA.CUSTOMERACCOUNTID AND BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = BCCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCA.SourceSystemCode
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBank DDB ON BCA.FINANCIALINSTITUTIONID = DDB.BANKID
LEFT JOIN DW.DimBranch DDBRAN ON BCA.BRANCHID = DDBRAN.BRANCHID AND DDBRAN.CurrentIndicator = 1
LEFT JOIN CoreCustomerAccountProfitCostCenter BCCC ON BCA.CustomerAccountId = BCCC.CustomerAccountId AND BCA.FinancialInstitutionId = BCCC.FinancialInstitutionId AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = BCCC.SourceSystemCode AND BCCC.ProfitCostCenterTypeId = 'Account PCC Code 1'
WHERE BCAS.CustomerAccountStatusTypeId != 'Disabled'
AND BCA.SourceSystemCode = 'TRY'
)a
